items.en_title: Varre-Sai (RJ) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 24 #43
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Varre-Sai (RJ) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 987,476; proposals close Nov 24, 17:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
